let loads = 0;
async function loadStart() {
  loads += 1;
  return 2;
}
async function collectRemaining() {
  const visited = [];
  for (let index = await loadStart(); index < 6; index++) {
    visited.push(index);
  }
  return visited;
}
collectRemaining().then((visited) => {
  if (loads !== 1 || JSON.stringify(visited) !== "[2,3,4,5]") throw new Error("Wrong loop behavior");
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ loads, visited }));
});
